facts.business: JD Cables Limited manufactures wires, cables, and conductors (including LT AB Cables, LT XLPE Power Cables, LT PVC Power and Control Cables, AAC, AAAC, and ACSR Conductors) and has expanded into infrastructure projects such as a National Highway development project under NHDP Phase V.
key_risks: Sharp volatility in key raw material prices, especially copper and aluminium, significantly influencing cost structures and margins
